\begin{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A muscle? (\textbf{o músculo}.) A thumb? (\textbf{o polegar}.) A wound? (\textbf{a ferida}.) A scar? (\textbf{a cicatriz}.) A cold? (\textbf{a constipação}.) Trust? (\textbf{a confiança}.) Courage? (\textbf{a coragem}.) Shame? (\textbf{a vergonha}.) Jealousy? (\textbf{o ciúme}.) Boredom? (\textbf{o tédio}.) Suddenly? (\textbf{de repente}.) Until? (\textbf{até}.) Since? (\textbf{desde}.) A decade? (\textbf{a década}.) The small hours? (\textbf{a madrugada}.) The outskirts? (\textbf{os arredores}.) The centre? (\textbf{o centro}.) A side? (\textbf{o lado}.) A corner? (\textbf{o canto}.) The middle? (\textbf{o meio}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Luckily? (\textbf{felizmente}.) Certainly? (\textbf{certamente}.) Really? (\textbf{realmente}.) Almost? (\textbf{quase}.) About? (\textbf{cerca de}.) Cheerful? (\textbf{alegre}.) Shy? (\textbf{tímido / tímida}.) Brave? (\textbf{corajoso / corajosa}.) Fearful? (\textbf{medroso / medrosa}.) Curious? (\textbf{curioso / curiosa}.) Different? (\textbf{diferente}.) The same? (\textbf{igual}.) Similar? (\textbf{parecido / parecida}.) Fair? (\textbf{justo / justa}.) False? (\textbf{falso / falsa}.) Hard-working? (\textbf{trabalhador / trabalhadora}.) Talkative? (\textbf{falador / faladora}.) Worried? (\textbf{preocupado / preocupada}.) With a cold? (\textbf{constipado / constipada}.) Single? (\textbf{solteiro / solteira}.) A bed sheet? (\textbf{o lençol}.) A drawer? (\textbf{a gaveta}.) An armchair? (\textbf{a poltrona}.) Pyjamas? (\textbf{o pijama}.) A button? (\textbf{o botão}.)
